claims.statement: For a rational recognizable series with state dimension r and all reduced realization numerators/denominators at most 2^H, evaluated on a jointly strictly upper-triangular rational tuple of dimension D whose entry heights are at most 2^B, every output entry has denominator dividing Q*=Q_lambda Q_gamma (Q_A Q_X)^(D-1), with log2 Q* <= 2rH+(D-1)(nr^2H+nD^2B). A deterministic per-entry rounded exact oracle with at least 2 log2 Q*+2 fractional bits can be reconstructed exactly by continued fractions, preserving an adaptive exact learner transcript subject to a charged rational-query-generation interface.
assumptions: The target has a rational linear realization of dimension r
Every input tuple is jointly strictly upper triangular
All realization and query rational-entry heights are bounded as supplied parameters
The exact learner's adaptive query generation and bit complexity are explicitly charged
claims.status: INTERNALLY_DERIVED_CYCLE2_CANDIDATE; PRIMARY PRIOR ART NOT CLEARED
claims.novelty_boundary: Rational reconstruction is classical. The local contribution is the explicit denominator bound for this finite nilpotent evaluation and its transcript/precision accounting. It is not a numerical stability theorem for arbitrary characteristic-zero series and does not validate L01.

costs.returned_bits: T D^2 times fractional precision plus charged integer-range bits
costs.reconstruction_time: T D^2 poly(log Q*, H, B, log(nrD)) bit operations, plus learner arithmetic
costs.input_bits: All rational query-entry descriptions charged; adaptive size growth is not bounded for a general learner

claims.falsifier: A rational response entry outside the stated denominator bound or a distinct rational with denominator <=Q* within the reconstruction radius would refute the claim.
claims.next_gate: Independent algebra review and a finite exact-versus-rounded adaptive transcript implementation.

claims.statement: For f_w(u)=1[u=w], w in [n]^d, minimal Hankel rank is d+1. One exact full-matrix rational query of dimension d+1 identifies w under sum_i X_i^T X_i <= I with polynomial input/output bit costs. Under the reconstructed adaptive full-matrix Gaussian oracle with fixed variance sigma^2 and the same per-query excitation cap, any zero-vs-hidden-word test with both errors <=delta has expected total query dimension and returned scalar entries at least 2 sigma^2 n^d kl(1-delta,delta).
assumptions: The exact input and output are rational and exact
For the noisy interface every returned matrix entry receives independent Gaussian noise of variance sigma^2
Each query obeys the aggregate per-call excitation constraint
C is expected total query dimension under the zero target
The test must distinguish zero from every hidden word with both errors <= delta < 1/2
claims.novelty_boundary: A finite exact-versus-noisy interface counterexample only. It does not refute or verify the universal L01 learner; prior art includes weighted-automaton learning and adaptive Gaussian sensing. Long Astra proof files were unavailable at the pinned commit.

costs.decoder: Polynomial bit time using a known prime-position table

claims.falsifier: An admissible adaptive Gaussian strategy below the bound or a collision in the exact prime-position encoding.
claims.next_gate: Retrieve and independently verify full N25 proof and targeted primary-source search for adaptive noisy noncommutative series evaluation under aggregate excitation.

claims.claim: Independent chosen-prefix full-suffix conditional samples recover s exactly with failure at most delta using m=ceil(2(1-2eta)^(-2)log(2T/delta)) calls per bit. The statistic R=(-1)^X(Z-1/2) has conditional mean plus or minus (1-2eta)/2.
assumptions: Known eta or certified upper bound below 1/2

resources.returned_suffixes: m*T*(T+1)/2 pair symbols = m*T*(T+1) bits; all suffix symbols charged
resources.communication: m*T^2 pair symbols = 2*m*T^2 raw bits, excluding framing
resources.memory: O(T+log m) bits with streamed responses; plus O(T) pair symbols if buffering a suffix
resources.runtime: O(m*T^2) bit operations including all I/O and prefix encoding
resources.precision: No numerical oracle output; exact half-integer arithmetic; T-bit feature output

prior_art.claim: Kakade et al. COLT 2023 Open Problem 1 asks for efficient chosen-prefix conditional-sample learning of any low-rank law. Liu and Moitra STOC 2025 Theorem 1.3 resolves arbitrary-rank distribution learning in TV with poly(S,|Omega|,T,1/epsilon) conditional queries/time and an efficiently samplable output.
prior_art.scope: Does not imply exact rare-history feature recovery at polynomial T: neighboring words have TV only (1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1)); a generic TV guarantee must take epsilon below half this gap. This is not a lower bound against a specialized algorithm.

claims.claim: For two words differing only in s_T, exact one-path TV is (1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1)). Any estimator on N iid passive paths has average last-bit error at least [1-N*(1-2eta)*2^(-(T-1))]/2; success >=2/3 requires N>=2^(T-1)/(3*(1-2eta)). At eta=1/4 this is 2^T/3.
claims.scope: Exact rare-history feature identification, not constant-TV distribution approximation.

claims.claim: For hidden Z=s·A and R independent Bernoulli(eta) readouts of the same Z in each reset episode, with theta=1-2eta>=beta>0 known, N=d+ceil(log2(2/delta)) random input episodes and odd R>=2 beta^-2 log(2N/delta) recover the exact dense mask s with probability >=1-delta by within-episode majority and GF(2) elimination. Once s is recovered, the acquired feature phi_t(h)=e_{partial parity} in R^2 updates by a learned swap on each input bit and identity on each readout bit. For every fixed cut t and every bounded future task g, conditional expectation is phi_t(h)^T w_{t,g}, with ||phi_t||2=1 and ||w_{t,g}||2<=sqrt(2). The state retains one parity bit and public position, not the observed prefix.

costs.memory: O(d^2+R) working bits with streaming row reduction, plus model storage.
costs.model: d mask bits plus known rational eta.

claims.scope: Independent repeated noisy readouts of the same persistent latent parity are load-bearing; matched same-data direct decoder returns the identical model and pays identical costs.
claims.prior_art_boundary: Independent repeated measurements of the same latent parity are load-bearing. The theorem does not establish arbitrary finite-state/HMM acquisition, arbitrary low-rank conditional-sampling results, or the teacher-assisted A06 recurrence target. Historical novelty is not cleared.

full_proofs: Each claim links to the corresponding child proof/report; all source calls, output symbols, precision, memory and runtime costs are retained there.
